gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP for FY2025-26 and Quarterly Estimates for Q4 (Jan-Mar) 2025-26, released June 5, 2026 (PIB press release). Q4 FY26 real GDP growth 7.8% YoY, flat vs Q3 FY26's 7.8%; full-year FY26 growth 7.7% (up from 7.1% in FY25).

cpi.source: MoSPI Press Release of Consumer Price Index on base 2024=100 for July 2026, released August 12, 2026. CPI inflation 4.45% YoY (rural 4.84%, urban 3.96%); CFPI food inflation 5.52% YoY. Note: released under revised 2024=100 base year series.

gsec10y.source: India 10-year G-Sec benchmark yield market coverage (BusinessToday, TradingEconomics): yield rose to 6.85% in July 2026 on higher crude and tight liquidity, then eased to ~6.75-6.79% by mid-August 2026 as oil prices softened.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% on August 5, 2026 (unanimous, fourth consecutive hold since Feb-Dec 2025 easing cycle paused); neutral stance retained. Headline CPI rose to 4.4% in June 2026, moving above the 4% target for the first time in sixteen months, driven mainly by food/fuel, limiting near-term cut prospects. Next MPC meeting Oct 5-7, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, August 3-5, 2026 (via Forbes India, IndiaBonds MPC coverage).

gov_capex.note: Centre's capex for Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026) rose to ₹3.4 lakh crore, 27.8% of the full-year Budget Estimate, vs ₹2.75 lakh crore (24.5%) in Q1 FY26 — capex-led growth strategy continues into FY27 despite fiscal deficit at only 18.2% of BE.
gov_capex.source: CGA Q1 FY27 data via Business Standard / Free Press Journal (July 31, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Manufacturing FDI growing faster than services FDI for the first time in years — a structural shift, not cyclical. March 2026 Press Note 3 amendments replaced the blanket Chinese-FDI ban with a three-pillar framework (automatic route for minority stakes, 60-day fast track, PMLA-aligned screening); commerce ministry signals India-China relations 'gradually normalizing' while PLI-driven manufacturing diversification continues.
china_plus_one.source: EcoNiti Daily Brief, 'India dilutes FDI curbs on China, softens anti-dumping stance' (August 2, 2026); commerce ministry FDI policy coverage.

rural_recovery.note: IMD forecasts below-normal rainfall (<94% of LPA) for August 2026 and the Aug-Sep second half of the monsoon on strengthening El Niño conditions. Kharif sowing at end-July 2026 covered 89.4 million hectares (81.0% of normal), YoY contraction narrowed to ~3% from ~23% in late June but still negative; pulses and coarse cereals down 6-8% YoY.
rural_recovery.source: USDA FAS 'India: Monsoon Recovery Fails to Boost Sluggish Crop Planting' (August 2026); ICRA Mid-Monsoon Update (August 2026).

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty 50 option chain aggregate PCR via NiftyTrader/NiftyInvest, as of August 13, 2026. Spot ~24,353; ATM strike 24,350 PCR 0.77, overall aggregate PCR ~0.75 (call OI positioning modestly outweighs puts).
